autonomous-worker-routing-certify.description: Certify zero-cost Spark route selection, exhausted-capacity retention and paid-fallback rejection without starting a model turn.

codex-spark-capacity-status-certify.description: Certify that raw Spark capacity, supervised physical admission and short-lived dispatch eligibility remain separate exact-byte evidence classes. Available capacity cannot bypass rejected, stale, broadened or over-concurrent admission; exhausted capacity remains exhausted and paid fallback remains forbidden.

codex-test-builder-completion-certify.description: Certify route-admission, supervised-acceptance and capability identity continuity through one Test Builder model turn. Only allowlisted uncommitted test changes can become ready for external deterministic validation; model output cannot claim tests passed, commit, publish or complete fixture certification as normal work.

codex-worker-result-classifier-certify.description: Certify observed Codex result classification for available, exhausted, rate-limited, authentication and degraded states without querying account usage or starting a model turn.

codex-worker-runner-safety-certify.description: Prove normal Codex Spark execution remains disabled without an explicit runtime gate and a supervised physical-acceptance envelope verified against the same fresh capability receipt. Certification remains fixture-only. Does not require Codex or start a model turn.

codex-worker-capability-probe.description: Inspect the installed Codex CLI version and exec help, proving supported structured-output, model-selection, sandbox and approval controls without authentication mutation, model inference or repository effects.

codex-chatgpt-auth-policy-probe.description: Inspect only Codex config/requirements policy to prove ChatGPT-only login enforcement without reading credentials, API keys or starting a model turn.

codex-chatgpt-auth-policy-certify.description: Certify ChatGPT-only Codex policy detection and rejection of API/mixed/unconfigured login policies using temporary fixtures only.

codex-spark-safe-certification-contract-.description: Verify the fail-closed physical-certification supervisor, supervised-envelope binding and absence of raw/supervised effectful Spark entrypoints from the routine worker task manifest. Does not start Codex or a model turn.

codex-spark-supervised-acceptance-certif.description: Verify supervised Spark physical-acceptance envelopes, nested acceptance digests and post-cleanup truth using synthetic receipts only. Raw acceptance, tampered digests and missing cleanup evidence must fail closed.
